annotations.text:
Stage 3-5 visual pass, carried three stages and now closed.

Values are lifted from modules/frontend/np.css; the three mesh and slice fills are marked in the source as renderer stand-ins, since the real canvas paints those from data.

Content is the reference bundle: Sherlock speech-feature group model, n = 26, estimands speech coefficient / articulatory rate / speech > silence, measures effect / standard error / t / z, 642-vertex lh-pial-surface and rh-pial-surface, one AR(2)/AR(1) warning. Bracketed values are placeholders; single-hemisphere and multi-surface cards are marked synthetic.

Chips mark the four answers that CHANGE what ships today: the link-readout split, the compact glyph wording, the conditional colour bar, and clipping the histogram's zero bin. Everything else documents the app as built.

Static artboards, not a prototype.
